# clang-tidy for the CI job and scripts/tidy.sh, a static build from PyPI
# (the clang-tidy wheel), pinned by hash. A new LLVM release adds checks to
# the families .clang-tidy runs whole, so bump by hand: run scripts/tidy.sh
# on the new version and fix or turn off what it finds in the same commit.
